items.title: Write a focused resolution execution plan for the three high gaps
items.context: The existing B-3a80 document is a triage and boundary plan. This story should add a concrete next execution plan for two signed-workspace binding gaps plus the Layer4 customerKeyRef future or blocked gap. It must avoid claiming the gaps are already fixed.
